AI translating some of Gincha's untranslated works. Will be prioritizing works with heavy BDSM themes and I will go back to translate other works.

I am not a professional translator nor editor. If you like this work and want to see it professionally translated or edited I encourage you to commission a professional. My goal is to make Gincha's, and the other authors that I chose to translate, works more popular with the idea of that getting more professional translations of their work.

This is the first comic from Happiness in Slavery:
